The role reports to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, who retains executive-level legal and regulatory strategy, overall oversight and escalation of material regulatory risk, Board-level reporting, significant legal interpretation, contractual/legal matters and major regulatory or enforcement matters.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and coordinate the central operational regulatory affairs and compliance framework, while supporting consistent regulatory standards and governance across Omnigame’s B2C and B2B activities.

• Lead and coordinate Omnigame’s central regulatory licensing portfolio and support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and relevant business owners with applications, renewals, variations, notifications and ongoing licence obligations.

• Act as a principal operational point of contact, together with the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, for gambling regulators and coordinate regulatory correspondence, inspections, enquiries and submissions, escalating material matters to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Assist with regulatory assessments for entry into new jurisdictions and ensure that market-entry requirements are identified, allocated and implemented.

• Own the regulatory reporting framework, including reporting calendars, quality assurance, submission governance and evidence of compliance.

• Lead regulatory change management: monitor developments, assess applicability and impact, allocate implementation actions, track remediation and ensure appropriate evidence and governance.

• Set or coordinate group-level compliance standards relevant to B2B counterparty due diligence where required and provide support or challenge on material matters.

• Coordinate cross-company regulatory standards for game, product and platform compliance and support material or cross-functional regulatory matters.

• Develop, maintain and improve compliance policies, procedures, controls, registers and monitoring arrangements.

• Identify material regulatory risks and control gaps, establish remediation plans and provide appropriate escalation and reporting to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Coordinate and oversee regulatory audits, assurance activities, inspections and responses to regulator information requests with assistance from relevant Regulatory Affairs Specialist.

• Partner with Product, Technology, Commercial, Operations, AML and Safer Gambling to embed regulatory requirements into business processes and change initiatives.

• Lead, allocate and quality-assure the work of direct Regulatory Affairs & Compliance team members and support their professional development.

• Promote clear ownership, consistent working methods and effective knowledge-sharing between the central Regulatory Affairs & Compliance function and embedded compliance resources.

• Prepare management information and regulatory/compliance reporting for the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and other relevant governance forums.

• Support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer in implementing the wider legal and compliance strategy and in material regulatory projects.

**Qualifications And Experience

**

• A relevant higher education degree within law, business law, compliance, governance, risk management or a comparable field.

• Significant experience in regulatory affairs or compliance within online gambling or another highly regulated industry, including experience operating at senior specialist, manager or head-of-function level.

• Strong understanding of gambling licensing, regulatory reporting, regulatory change management and operational compliance frameworks.

• Experience leading or coordinating multi-jurisdictional regulatory projects and regulator interactions.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes and business decisions.

• Experience managing, mentoring or coordinating compliance professionals and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong judgement, organization and communication skills, including the ability to identify matters requiring executive escalation.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written; additional language skills are an advantage.

****Do you want to join the team?

****Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant supporting documents by clicking the "Apply for this job" button.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Portfolio Analysis is where investment professionals turn data into insight on portfolios, performance and risk. Our products are business critical and widely used, so they need to keep evolving in a responsible way. Right now that means strong maintainability, high system performance, mature CI/CD, and reshaping parts of SimCorp Dimension for the cloud.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Product Division, you will join an agile team of 5–7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. You will mainly work on backend components, APIs and services, using C#, .NET, Dyalog APL and Oracle.

AI is part of how we work every day. We see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work and build better software.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Understand and challenge customer requirements together with your team, then design, implement, test and support the chosen solutions

• Design, develop and maintain backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET, and work with Dyalog APL where it is part of the product

• Contribute to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value

• Improve performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience

• Take ownership beyond code: contribute to design discussions and help the team make sound technical decisions

• Use CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work

• Use AI every day in practical engineering work, such as exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, prototyping, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks

• Help the team discover where AI creates real value and where traditional engineering judgment should lead

• Collaborate with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software

**What We Value

**How you gained your skills matters less than your ability to learn, collaborate and take ownership. We expect you to know some of the following and to be interested in learning the rest:

• C# and .NET development, backend development and API design

• Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications

• Continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and practical quality engineering

• Relational databases, preferably Oracle or similar

• Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services

• Willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL

• Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and daily use of modern tools

• Experience with financial instruments or investment systems is an advantage but not a requirement. We will bring you up to speed through training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

We also value people who take ownership and deliver results. We look for engineers who try new approaches, work with others to leverage everyone’s strengths, and balance technical quality with business value. We want you to help build an inclusive, trust-based engineering culture.

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy – We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. You can work remotely the other days if you choose.

• Growth and innovation – Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements.

• Self-direction – Teams and developers have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Modern engineering in a real product context – You will work on cloud modernization, AI-enabled development and performance in large-scale financial software.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture – We want people to bring different perspectives and contribute to a respectful workplace.

• Work-life balance – We believe balance between professional and private life makes us better colleagues and better engineers.

• Empowerment – All voices are valuable, and you will be involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**We are 3,000 colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and skills are integrated into our everyday work.

Senior Technician, Quality Control

**Senior Laboratory Technician (Laborant), QC Bioassay

**Our purpose is to bring hope to life by enabling life-changing therapies for patients around the globe, creating a healthier and happier tomorrow. Our mission is to work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

****QC Bioassay is growing! Now is your chance to become Senior Laboratory Technician! Read more about AGC Biologics, QC and the roles below - if you are still intrigued by the opportunity, don't hesitate to apply today!

**We are offering a permanent 37-hour positions as Senior Laboratory Technicians in a well-functioning QC Bioassay team with an informal work environment, close collaboration, and the opportunity to gain broad insight into how a bioassay department operates within an international contract manufacturing organization (CDMO). The roles are based on site in our facility in Søborg, and together with your colleagues, you will be covering the daily lab work and a weekend shift once or twice a month, depending on the schedules. The positions also require availability for Stop'n Go on-call phone duties to support manufacturing activities.

**Join a big & international QC organization!

**QC Bioassay is one of five departments in our big QC Organization. In QC Bioassay we are in total 51 highly skilled employees: Scientists and Technicians. QC Bioassay is divided into four groups: Bioassay Technicians, Bioassay Scientists, Bioassay Cell & Reference Material, and General Analytics.

We perform a broad range of compendial methods, bioassays, as well as cell-based assays. We are responsible for method validations for early and late-stage products, release testing of clinical and commercial batches (DS and DP) as well as testing of stability samples. Finally, but not least, we are responsible for supporting the 24/7 operating manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals by testing in-process stop/go samples.

We hope this introduction gives you a flavor of the great purpose and significant responsibilities that drive our dedicated QC colleagues every day. We are not just a big but also an international and diverse group of people delivering based on cross-collaboration and support, especially of new colleagues like you.

You will be working in spacious, well-equipped laboratories, with opportunities to develop your expertise as a specialist while gaining experience with other analytical methods.

**Are you passionate about bioanalytical methods, like ELISA?

**As a Senior Technician in QC Bioassay, you will quickly be involved in our analytical testing of drug substance and drug product samples as well as in-process samples. Moreover, you will be involved in stability programs and validation of methods used for phase I/II and phase III/Commercial products.

This role fits well with someone who is passionate about executing a variety of Bioanalytical methods (e.g., ELISA, Octet, qPCR and cell-based assays), as this will be your main responsibility. You will be reporting results, including data processing in LIMS and setup. Further, your tasks will include participating in method validation studies, troubleshooting of methods and on-time testing of stop/go samples to support our manufacturing facility.

**Your degree as laboratory technician comes well into play with us!

**The ideal candidate holds a degree as laboratory technician (laborant). All our testing is performed according to the cGMP, so your understanding and experience of this is highly appreciated. Hands-on experience with ELISA is a strong advantage for this role, and experience with cell-based assays is also appreciated. However, we also welcome applications from candidates with a relevant laboratory background and an interest in developing their skills within these methods. Our corporate language is English, so you must be fluent both in spoken and written form.

In order to deliver a high level of quality, your structured mindset will be key to achieve this, but in a fast-paced environment like ours the priorities may change, so our new colleagues will thrive the best if they have a positive attitude to tight deadlines and adjusting to the new priorities without compromising on quality. Being adaptable and resilient when plans change, including handling unexpected adjustments and replanning of activities, is important in this role.
